census.replayStatus: The dedicated census receipt binds itself to this campaign's canonical hash, pinned file/version, and target set; census-011.mjs --check verifies that binding offline. The receipt SHA is intentionally not duplicated here, because doing so would make the campaign/receipt integrity binding cyclic.

endpoints: HTTPS CDN URL returned by the image index

blockedConditions.requiredCoverage: The contract requires etat(2) x optionnel(2) x saisie(3) = 12 combinations. The census pins only four Normal combinations: input/required, input/optional, select/required and textarea/required.
blockedConditions.evidence: source-census.json records seven Field instances, all from main component 2056:1265 (Etat=Normal): five input, one optional input, one select and one textarea. Component 2056:1271 (Etat=Erreur) exists in the immutable set catalog but has zero page instances; it is not substituted for a non-default instance.
blockedConditions.resolution: Find pre-existing immutable instances for each listed combination. Do not manufacture them by changing the master.

blockedConditions.requiredCoverage: Every observed immutable Saisie child and value must be rendered as the exact input, select, or textarea content of its Field occurrence, rather than as Field's default ds.input content.
blockedConditions.evidence: The campaign pins Input instances I2096:2714;2096:2551 (Prénom) and I2096:2714;2096:2555 (Téléphone), plus the select and textarea swaps I2096:2714;2096:2559 and I2096:2714;2096:2561. The current comparison input supports top-level Field props only; it cannot bind the required slotted child or its immutable value. Rendering any of these cases as Field's default input would be a false comparison.
blockedConditions.resolution: Add a fixture-first, contract-bound comparison input for the restricted Saisie child and its value before trying to accept an observed Field occurrence.

evidence.finding: All eight immutable ProductCard instances declare Bouton=false; no immutable Bouton=true instance exists in the census.

blockedConditions.resolution: Find a pre-existing Bouton=true instance through a read-only GET and pin it. Rendering the master with a temporary property is prohibited.

blockedConditions.requiredCoverage: The shared fun-ia IMAGE plane and the 16 occurrence-specific normal portraits retained by the census.

evidence.finding: All portrait bytes are bindable through MemberCard.imageUrl. The composed MemberPicture funIa plane has no source prop, so its materialized shared IMAGE receipt cannot be injected into the generated comparison.

blockedConditions.resolution: Add a contract-bound, fixture-proven scalar for the MemberPicture base plane before claiming exact two-paint comparison coverage.
